coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am interested in the Data Scientist role at OpenBrand, particularly its emphasis on maintaining reliable production products and delivering useful client-facing outputs. My background combines software development, systems integration, operational analysis, and client support. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, with responsibilities extending from implementation requirements through troubleshooting and documentation. That experience provides a practical foundation for the engineering and delivery aspects of this position.

Two examples illustrate the experience I would bring. At DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the platform, broadened support for financial platforms and tax providers, optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput, and migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. Alongside development, I supported implementations through setup and go-live, communicated project status to clients, and maintained integration guides and knowledge-base articles. This work connects directly to OpenBrand’s emphasis on ongoing production ownership, investigation, and documented delivery. Earlier, at Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I analyzed asset and facilities databases and identified more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value, informing the sale of unused assets before Komatsu’s acquisition of Joy Global. I also initiated web automations to reduce manual database maintenance and designed SharePoint data-input forms to reduce errors and improve information sharing.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this combination of production development and operational analysis could support OpenBrand’s market intelligence products. The role’s connection between technical implementation and information that informs business decisions is especially appealing in relation to my prior work. Thank you for considering my application.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasizes production platform ownership, integration delivery, AWS migration, performance improvements, documentation, and operational database analysis. The master does not establish five years in data science or analytical modeling, production statistical models, estimation and calibration methods, advanced Python analytics libraries, large-scale analytical SQL, alternative-data measurement, or LLM use in data science workflows. The BBA differs from the requested analytical BS/MS background.
